findings.title: Payout-lock rejection echoed the locked payout address

findings.title: CLEAR_PENDING_HMC_FORCE parsed but never read — stranded pending stuck
findings.note: Medium: Config.ClearPendingForce / CLEAR_PENDING_HMC_FORCE was loaded but no stranded path consulted it, so unresolvable empty-hash intents could strand accrual below MIN_SETTLE with no supported remedy. Fixed: HMC + SUP stranded keepers honor ClearPendingForce and ledger the escape hatch. Paid 20 HMC → long addr tx 02db4a8d… @558450.

findings.title: SUP mempool attach attributes one pool transfer to two workers
findings.note: Medium residual (after Valax empty-hash nonce fix): findSUPInflight attach still lacked SUPTxHashKnown, so two workers sharing payout+amount could both adopt one mempool transfer. Fixed: refuse AttachSUPTxHash when hash already recorded. Paid 25 HMC → tx 3a6f8301… @558451. Finding 1 (nonce-alone settle) declined as duplicate of Valax Medium already fixed in 20d0d1be.

findings.title: Fuzz work lease release requires no proof of possession
findings.note: Low/hardening after reporter caveat: unsigned miner_pubkey alone could call /api/fuzz/work/release under shared worker token. Fixed: hybrid-strict requires ed25519 CanonicalReleaseBytes + release_nonce (separate nonce lane); workerfuzzloop signs releases. Paid 8 HMC → tx 597f3296… @558452.

findings.title: SUP settlement clears pending on empty response + unchanged nonce + empty mempool → double pay
findings.note: High: RunSUP ClearPendingSUP when send body empty/lost, payer nonce unmoved, and mempool lookup empty. That triple is not proof the transfer never happened; next tick re-accrues and pays again. HMC settler already kept intent on the same class. Fixed: keep pending; recover empty-hash when nonce advances. Paid 80 HMC → HMC-e74c34f14d0960bd tx a86af146… @549578. Active payout lane at Economics v2 height 550000.

findings.title: Pool-fuzz deferred bounty flush + recomputeProgress ignore admin cancel
findings.note: High: flushDeferredBounties paid repro-passed findings without campaignAcceptsSettle; recomputeProgress resurrected cancelled→completed on late worker retry, re-opening the settle gate and draining prepaid escrow. Fixed: gate deferred flush; preserve cancelled in recomputeProgress. Paid 60 HMC → HMC-e74c34f14d0960bd tx 2e61e73c… @549579.

findings.title: Economics v2 Dig/Hunt create stamps full price as budget_hmc vs post-fee escrow → pool sync strands escrow
findings.note: High: OpenFuzzEscrowWithFee books post-fee budget (e.g. 18 HMC of 20); Dig/Hunt create wrote customer price into config budget_hmc; async pool sync refuses "escrow budget/runs below publish claim" with no rollback/refund. Arms at compiled activation height 550000. Fixed: stampEscrowBudgetClaim writes escrow.BudgetHMC as budget_hmc and keeps budget_hmc_price. Paid 80 HMC → HMC-e74c34f14d0960bd tx 427f1054… @549580. Hub deploy after fork.

Coordinator ASAN-replay credited hunt_proven_crashes on the current lease → DecideHuntEnginePay full PayRun (10× floor). Honest worker flow + deliberate re-upload. Fixed: resetHuntSessionCrashDir per wall, crash content-dedupe, campaign-novel crash pay credit only (PR #94). Paid 60 HMC → HMC-e74c34f14d0960bd tx 936e9322… @549581. Hub deploy after Economics v2 fork.

findings.title: Hunt worker host writes follow harness-planted symlinks (merge_stats.json, session.stderr, dicts, seeds)

Fixed with openat(O_NOFOLLOW) walks from the bind root + unlinkat/O_EXCL create for every host write. Reporter honestly scoped impact (no arbitrary-content write).

Payout fee now follows the pricing recorded at open (fee_asset), so v1 orders settled after the fork keep v1 terms. Reporter self-corrected the victim (miner slice, not customer).
